# AI-SMARTSERVE - Smart Cafe Menu & Ordering Platform

> AI-SMARTSERVE provides smart cafe digital menu ordering with AI Sommelier assistance and contactless QR payment.

## Project Information
- Name: AI-SMARTSERVE (WebCafe)
- URL: https://www.ai-smartserve.io.vn
- Category: Smart F&B Ordering & E-commerce System

## Key Features
- Handcrafted Menu with Coffee, Milk Tea, Fruit Tea, and Bakery.
- AI Sommelier drink recommendations and personalized pairing.
- Seamless VietQR PayOS payment integration.
- Real-time order status tracking with SignalR.
